module: Module 6: Independent Sub-Account Margin, Leverage & Stop-Outs
title: Isolated Stop-Out Forced Liquidation on Single Sub-Account
precondition: Sub-account #3 margin level touches broker stop-out threshold (50%).
steps: 1. Broker executes forced liquidation on Sub-account #3.
expected_result: Sub-account #3 child position closed at market; remaining 9 sub-accounts and master position REMAIN OPEN; zero group contagion.
actual_result: Stop-out liquidation is strictly isolated: Sub-account position liquidated at market; master and remaining sub-accounts stay open.
